findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
findings.comment: There were multiple employees and no signed employee reporting agreements available. CORRECTED- All present employees signed an employee reporting agreement and discussed storing them in a safe place for all future inspections. Ensure that there are signed employee reporting agreements for all employees available for all future inspections.
findings.citation_text: 2-103.11(P) Person In Charge. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall ensure that: (P) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the PERSON IN CHARGE, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD, as specified under 2-201.11(A).

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: There were no Quaternary ammonium sanitizer test strips available for the Quat sanitizer. CORRECTED- Inspector provided Quat test strips and the PIC stated that they have ordered more. Ensure that there are test strips available for every type of sanitizer used.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Observed a cooler unit to be cold holding burgers at 50F. Discussed with PIC, cooler will get serviced. An ice bath was created to cold hold burgers, and the church the mobile was parked at allowed for some burger to be kept in their coolers, which ran 38F. Ensure any TCS food being cold held is kept at or below 41F. 

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer to be set up upon arrival. Discussed with PIC, triple sink was set up and tested at 200 ppm Quat. Ensure sanitizer is set up at the proper concentration at all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text:
4-303.11 (A) Cleaning agents that are used to clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-6, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. 
(B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Allergen training as required
findings.comment:
Observed no CFM to have completed the required allergen training. Discussed with PIC, ensure all CFM’s have allergen training completed. 

410 ILCS 625/3.07 Sec. 3.07. Allergen awareness training. (b) Unless otherwise provided, all certified food service sanitation managers employed by a restaurant must receive or obtain training in basic allergen awareness principles within 30 days after employment and every 3 years thereafter.
